product.title: Shoebox Monthly Subscription
product.body_html:
After receiving many requests for a sub, we have finally reached the operational efficiency and organization that makes it possible. Our 2 bag sub(launching March 5th) and the 4 bag sub(launching April 5th) will be opening with a limited amount of slots per option. We intend to grow the sub carefully and steadily over time, so if you miss it at launch, try back the next month as we will continue to add more slots over time. 

2x125g bag sub: 2 unique lightly roasted coffees delivered to your door, billed the 5th of every month and shipping the following week. Expect mostly clean washed coffees with an abundance of juicy acidity and pretty florals. 

 

4x125g bag sub: 4 bags of lightly roasted coffee delivered each month, with a guaranteed 3 unique offerings in each delivery. Expect a little more variety on this one, and potentially 2 bags of our favorite coffee from each drop alongside some more exploratory process methods and fruitier naturals. Those with a fear of flavor need not apply(releasing April 5th.)

Extra info:

  • All subscriptions ship free!
  • Fixed, slightly more affordable pricing on all subs
  • Easily combine shipping for addon coffees using code SHOE
